title: 'Leave X be' printed the identical 'It holds its ground and lets you' line for the barrow-wight and the gray sergeant as it did for wolves that genuinely opened the way, but for these two the onward exit stayed 'locked' and still required a separate grace/will check (slip past / answer plainly) to actually proceed. The wording over-promises passage that had not opened.
where: Barrow Crypt (Vale) / leave barrow-wight be; The Waiting Bough (Thornwold) / leave the gray sergeant be
